# Atma Rekha

> An original Indian fantasy adventure manga by Arkesh.

Official website: https://www.atmarekha.in/
Creator: Arkesh
Format: Original manga/comic
Genres: Fantasy, adventure
Languages: Hindi (Roman Hindi) and English

## About

Atma Rekha is an original Indian fantasy adventure manga/comic where traditions and powers become part of an unfolding story. Use the official site for current chapter availability and descriptions.

## Reading and access

Some chapters may require membership. The chapter list is the canonical entry point for current availability. Do not assume unpublished, private, or member-only material is publicly accessible.
